CREATE TABLE D360.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE_TRANPARTICULAR
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH([ACID]),
    HEAP
)
AS

WITH DEP_HTD AS (
    SELECT TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,TRAN_RMKS,ACID,TRAN_PARTICULAR FROM EDS.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE GROUP BY TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,TRAN_RMKS,TRAN_PARTICULAR,ACID
)
SELECT  TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,TRAN_RMKS,ACID,TRAN_PARTICULAR,VALUE AS TRAN_PARTICULAR_DETAILS,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,TRAN_RMKS ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) SEQ_NO 
FROM DEP_HTD 
CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRAN_PARTICULAR,' ','|'),'||','|'), '|')
